final: WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT f.film_id) AS film_count FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), rating_shares AS (SELECT rating, film_count, 1.0 * film_count / SUM(film_count) OVER () AS share FROM rating_counts), share_average AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM rating_shares) SELECT COUNT(*) AS rating_count, AVG(rs.share) AS average_share, AVG(rs.share - sa.avg_share) AS average_excess_share FROM rating_shares rs CROSS JOIN share_average sa WHERE rs.share > sa.avg_share
